criteria.requirement: Add TabularOutputFormatter.stream_output(data,headers,format_name=None,preprocessors=(),column_types=None,**kwargs) for registered CSV/TSV/JSONL formats only. Require explicit column types matching finite materialized headers to avoid whole-result inference; run the same registered/extra preprocessors lazily and return the original adapter iterator without list(data). Copy format defaults per call, preserve row errors/cancellation and Unicode/newline conventions, reject layout/table formats and invalid metadata before consuming a data row. Existing format_output remains unchanged.
